title: Hook results
description: Results of hook.<name> requests. Each subscriber answers with an Answer; the emitter receives the Outcome of the whole chain. Payloads are in hooks/<name>.json.

reason.description: Why; present when result is reject.

Outcome.description: What the emitter receives: continue if every subscriber continued or there are none, otherwise the first reject.

reason.description: The rejecting subscriber's reason; present when result is reject.

by.description: The rejecting subscriber; present when result is reject.
